data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of $5.407 million in its prior year claims reserves, representing a 11.5% increase relative to its opening gross claims outstanding. This deterioration is attributed to adverse claims development, particularly from natural catastrophe events in 2018 and 2019, as indicated by industry experience. The syndicate primarily underwrites Property Treaty reinsurance business.

No explicit gross prior year development figure was available. Gross premium mix is inferred from the 'Property Treaty business' description as no detailed segmental analysis for 2020 was provided.
